description: STREAM behavior through the SQL surface - SHOW STREAMS cells and reads of the stream itself (METADATA$ACTION / METADATA$ISUPDATE per change row): creation over a table (source_type Table, mode DEFAULT or APPEND_ONLY), a qualified stream reference resolving from another schema, a read through IDENTIFIER(), the delta reported for inserts, updates (a DELETE+INSERT pair both flagged as an update) and deletes, APPEND_ONLY keeping only the insert, consumption by a DML that reads the stream, DROP STREAM, and a stream on a VIEW surviving a database CLONE (still readable by name and through IDENTIFIER, still listed with source_type View). Converted 1:1 from features/StreamsTest (now retired).
